summary: Frontend testing for 3 flows (notif bell filters, checkout garantie CREDI'SCOP alert, /notifications regression). Flows 1 and 3 fully pass end-to-end. Flow 2 is validated at backend + frontend code level (GET /api/rar/checkout-context returns credits_required_cents=5702, credits_value_cents=2300, credits_missing_cents=3402, suggested_pack Pack Régulier 150cr, logistics_cost_cents=12670, credit_coverage_pct=45 for a cart of 60x Huile de tournesol 5L). Full end-to-end UI verification of the amber warning at checkout step 4 was blocked by a pre-existing signature-OTP failure (POST to signature init returns HTTP 422 and toast displays '[object Object],[object Object]...'). The CheckoutPayment.jsx render logic (lines 172-192) is code-reviewed as correct: warning rendered outside codEligible block, testids rar-guarantee-warning, rar-guarantee-missing, rar-guarantee-recharge-link with href='/mon-crediscop' all present.

ui_bugs.issue: POST /api/signatures/initiate returns 422 (validation error) when triggered from checkout Signature step for acheteur-pro. Toast renders raw error array as '[object Object],[object Object],[object Object],[object Object]' instead of a human-readable French message. Blocks the buyer from reaching the Payment step (step 4). Reproduced with acheteur-pro@kdmarche.fr + cart of Huile de tournesol 5L x60.

action_items: Fix POST /api/signatures/initiate 422 for acheteur-pro during checkout signature step — inspect payload emitted by SMSSignatureModal (document_type/document_ref/signer) vs SignatureInitiate schema; buyer profile may be missing signer.first_name/last_name/phone required fields.

Improve error toast: currently displays serialized FastAPI validation error array (each entry becomes '[object Object]'); should map to a French sentence like 'Numéro de téléphone signataire manquant, complétez votre profil.'
Once signature works, re-run Flow 2 to visually confirm rar-guarantee-warning renders with amber styling and the Recharger link navigates to /mon-crediscop.
critical_code_review_comments: CheckoutPayment.jsx (line 172-192): rar-guarantee-warning conditional is correct and independent of codEligible — good. Uses credit_coverage_pct default 45 fallback — good.
NotificationsBell.jsx: classifyNotif properly routes stock/promo/auction/other; empty-state message differentiates 'Aucune notification' vs 'Aucune notification dans cette catégorie.' — good.
NotificationsPage.jsx: renders separate testids (notifications-empty / notifications-filter-empty / notifications-list) depending on state — clean separation.
Signature error handling in SMSSignatureModal: toast.error(err.message) receives an object → results in '[object Object]' rendering. Should JSON.stringify or extract detail[0].msg.
Cart click billing (routes_cart_v2.py L167-168): charge_click after ALL validations pass — good design (no CPC debit if 400/404 error).
